title: Every edit keeps the raw underneath
text: For J and L cuts, always duplicate the layer on top and edit the copy; the raw layer stays below as backup (same idea as 1RaceClub RC-15).

source.heading: From the user's verdict on the 20261125 YT agent v1 (2026-11-25; HKS-C27 to C31 confirmed)

confirm: Is the raw layer untouched under every trimmed copy?
